description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain that prides itself on using 100% Canadian wheat dough made fresh in-house and organic tomato sauce, with most meats raised without antibiotics. This North Vancouver location operates as takeout-only with no indoor or outdoor seating, making it a grab-and-go stop for hungry cyclists. The menu includes pizzas, salads, sides, and a range of plant-based and dairy-free options.
